summary.headline: Shipwreck Judgment and Fugitives
summary.text: Astrological judgment of a ship’s storm, cargo, transfers, and arrival, using planetary rulers, zodiacal signs, lots, houses, terms, and rising figures including Argo, Asclepius, and Hygeia. A new section by Demetrius begins, explaining horoscopic significators for fugitives and their recovery.
